plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Chemistry map for 2026-2027' and states 'This pathway map is for catalog year 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row; Table View shows no prerequisites column, so the 'Prerequisites' flags below are Card View only. This plan transcribes the 2026-2027 pathway 'Bakersfield College / Chemistry / Associate in Science for Transfer / 63-68.5 units / 4 terms / to CSU' in full; the page shows only the 4-term Bakersfield College segment. The map prints term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-16 / 15-16 / 18-20. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4); Term 3 'Area 3B : Humanities' (3-4); Term 4 'Area 5B : Biological Sciences' (3-5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 63 units. This map was HELD in Wave118 because the first capture listed fewer rows than the term totals required; the 2026-11-16 re-extraction captured all 17 course rows (4 + 4 + 4 + 5) and every term reconciles exactly at minimums, so the hold is cleared. CHEM B1A and MATH C2211 are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; they are named major courses and are recorded with category 'major'. POLS C1000 is printed as a named General Education course and is recorded with category 'core'. CHEM B1A, MATH C2211, CHEM B1B, MATH C2221, CHEM B30A, PHYS B4A, CHEM B30B and PHYS B4B carry a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; no other row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag, so no other prereqs are recorded. The Term 3 'History' slot text states verbatim: 'Choose a course from the History area of the Bakersfield College General Education pattern. To meet the overall degree requirements, your course must also satisfy CSU General Education-Breadth Area D. HIST B1 or HIST B4A will also satisfy the U.S. History requirement.' General-education slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded.
